paragraphs: Rav Ada bar Rav Aza, [Kiddushin 81b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.81b.13). Rav Acha or Rava bar Rav Aza, [Temurah 21a](https://www.sefaria.org/Temurah.21a.6).[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Kiddushin Hebrew prints Aza in parentheses and Awa in brackets. In that occurrence Rav Ada speaks in Rav Assi’s name. Temurah reads Rava bar Rav Aza. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=230&lang=en) gives Ada bar Rav Aza as its heading.
